cohort: 187 women who gave birth at the Soroka University Medical Center (SUMC), Beer-Sheva, Israel
finding: There was no significant association between the presence or severity of striae gravidarum and the occurrence of perineal tears.
mod_finding: The presence of striae gravidarum was not associated with perineal tears.
birth_weight: Neonates of mothers with SG were significantly larger
